sentences.text: I have gone through the first information report, which does not reflect name of the applicant.
His involvement surfaced in the communication dated 20.04.2024, seeking the custody of accused.
Considering the allegations in the FIR and the contents of report dated 20.04.2024, the applicant deserves protection.
Learned counsel for the applicant informs that his client schedules to proceed on Haj pilgrimage from 30.05.2024.

On instructions he submits that his client is ready to co-operate and attend the concern police station on 28.05.2024 and 29.05.2024.
4.
Issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 24.06.2024.
Learned A. P. P. waives notice for respondent/State.

5. Call for papers from the concerned police station.
